how: Known-answer twins: 640 letters of held-out period Italian (never in the language model's training text), enciphered homophonically with 51 cipher signs like this letter, then a share of the cipher signs replaced by other signs drawn by frequency (simulated misreads), and attacked the same way as the letter (homophonic annealing from random starts, 400,000 iterations x 48 restarts) but without clear-text context. letters_right = share of letters decoded correctly. Run 19 October 2026.
compare: The letter's whole-stream decode scores 3.5 bits per letter (controls.json, whole_stream_decodes) with the clear text as context, which the twins do not have; the comparison is rough.
